headline: Three o'clock keeps the lamps.
body: The river holds a single barge light and refuses the rest. A fox crosses the service road without looking up. Somewhere a printer in an empty office finishes a job no one asked for.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: indigo thinning at the edges, no stars worth naming

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet tarmac, one taxi idling with its meter dark

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: kitchen windows on the third floor, still deciding
